# Spatial tendon

Query target: `SPATIAL_TENDON`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

| Attribute | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [tendonDamping](#tendondamping) | read/write | damping |
| [tendonInstance](#tendoninstance) | read | multi-apply instance name for this tendon row |
| [tendonLimitStiffness](#tendonlimitstiffness) | read/write | limit-region stiffness |
| [tendonOffset](#tendonoffset) | read/write | offset |
| [tendonStiffness](#tendonstiffness) | read/write | stiffness |

## tendonDamping

`f32`; units: [mass / sec](units.md#linear-damping).

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Read | fixed, shape [objects], 1 lanes | scene device |
| Write | fixed, shape [objects], 1 lanes | scene device |

**Read:** requires [DirectGPU warmup](#directgpu-warmup).

**Write:** requires [DirectGPU warmup](#directgpu-warmup).

Sets input; persists until replaced. Visibility: commit.

## tendonInstance

`u64`; units: [not applicable](units.md#not-applicable).

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Read | fixed, shape [objects], 1 lanes | CPU |

**Read:** requires [DirectGPU warmup](#directgpu-warmup).

One interned instance token per tendon row, in the same order as the other SPATIAL_TENDON columns. The row prim is the root prim and may repeat. Pair this token with that prim to match spatialTendonRoot and spatialTendonInstance; that pair is articulation slot T. This row order is database order, not getSpatialTendons order.

## Conditions

### DirectGPU warmup

Device-backed DirectGPU state requires a completed first step; a write never warms the simulation automatically.
